title: THE PIXEL PILLAGER
why: His orders of 2026-10-20 (22:45 to 23:05): the whole game in pixel art like the style test, 3 heads, 3 skins and 3 clothes with a pack. Job 86c, ship 1: one pixel body for every plain pillager (you, your mate, hires and the pillager bots), baked in layers, with a pixel gun and arms in 32 aim steps, behind the pixel look switch.
now: With the pixel look on, every plain pillager is a pixel figure with a pixel gun. Armour, hits, downed, fists and sets still draw the old figure.
